transcript: The proposal artifact is canonically serialized as JSON with all object keys sorted recursively in lexicographic order and all whitespace removed, producing proposal_canon.json in byte-exact form. A third party reproduces hProposal by computing sha256(proposal_canon.json); the seed seedHex is then derived as sha256(hProposal + salt) where hProposal=966701d66b878a3be114abbd340639e4032bc8cf1d22fe0af46656cceaa79886 and salt=1d3e427a18bae2d1cb66845c0f89d8b379d5eb07ba3f68b64695bd4bbde54bc3. This CENSUS draw selects all 85 witnesses from census.json in their stated order, without replacement, as the deterministic witness set for validation.
